**People Directory 1/PeopleData.swift:64**

### CSV parser mishandles escaped double-quote characters

**Low Severity**

<!-- DESCRIPTION START -->
The `parseCSVLine` function doesn't handle RFC 4180 escaped double quotes. In standard CSV, `""` inside a quoted field represents a literal `"` character. The parser instead toggles `inQuotes` twice (off then on), silently dropping the quote. The current `people.csv` data doesn't trigger this, but the parser already handles quoted fields with commas (e.g. `"Consumer Experience,Ads & Promos"`), so it's reasonable to expect correct handling of the full quoting spec — especially since the CSV is people directory data that may be updated.
<!-- DESCRIPTION END -->
